title: precision frame scrub on seek bar

commit.merge_subject: merge: precision frame scrub on seek bar

description:
Owner request 2026-11-11 section 2: frame-precision work needs slow,
frame-by-frame positioning. Normal mode stays as-is (drag maps to time,
~1 cm seeks ~3 s); a press-and-hold on the seek bar that survives the
platform long-press window now enters PRECISION FRAME MODE — the same
physical drag steps whole frames (~1 cm = 30 frames, i.e. ~2.1 dp per
frame, round-to-nearest so sub-half-dp wiggles hold the frame), a
readout with the exact 1-based frame number + timecode appears above
the bar ("the player bar becomes more detailed"), and releasing keeps
the parked frame (pause behavior + the existing progressive full-res
settle).

- PrecisionScrubUi.kt: the gesture modifier + readout composable. The
  modifier rides the M3 Slider's own modifier, i.e. OUTER to its
  internal detectTapGestures/draggable chains, so it watches the
  long-press window in the INITIAL pass (verified from foundation
changed: feat: precision scrub on the seek bar
